environment.runtime: Native WKWebView with production frontend assets and debug Rust.

builds.recipe: For the primary comparison, use clean disposable checkouts of the sourceCommit for committedBaseline and committedFinal. In each run mise exec -- bun install --frozen-lockfile, then mise exec -- just drive-build. Keep the two src-tauri/target/debug/trunk-drive outputs at separate absolute paths.

committedBaseline.sourceComparison: The executable built from 6fd5a288 has the same application and build inputs as 345af69e. The full revision diff touches GLOSSARY.md and three files under docs/.

committedFinal.sourceWitness: Source-tree fingerprints captured before and after the drive build match the committed tree.

before.sourceComparison: The full revision diff touched only GLOSSARY.md and three files under docs/.

candidate.sourceScope: Historical finder, preview and picker candidate. The Vite build preceded the App.svelte and repository-tabs.svelte.ts edits in the later integration tree.

pinnedIntegration.scope: Historical integration picker and Start replay. The source tree and patch digest identify the captured source.

startSafetyCandidate.scope: Historical candidate for the functional Start and scroll-then-Enter observations.

protocol.fixture: Fresh SHA-1 repository per trial. C1 adds 8,000 numbered project files, C2 adds change-1.txt, C3 adds change-2.txt, and main and 60 topic branches point to C3. Local branch release points to C2 and tag release to C1. C1 short SHA is 655ba48.
protocol.startup: Use separate drive launches for the rebase preview and finder within each trial. The drive client seeds isolated preferences and the runner waits for a graph row. The finder clock starts in the page after opening Review and waiting for Comment on a file.
protocol.inputMs: From immediately before the finder click to the MutationObserver callback that first sees its combobox.
protocol.firstRowMs: From the same start to the first callback that sees any result option and measures its height. The candidate can initially mount a single option while waiting for viewport dimensions.
protocol.rowsMs: From the same start to the first callback with at least ceil(list.clientHeight / rowHeight) options. The observed 435 px list and 34 px rows require 13 options, including the partly visible row. The candidate mounted 26 with overscan.
protocol.narrow.ms: Set file-1999 on the combobox, start the clock before dispatching the input event, then read the options after one microtask.
protocol.limits: These are whole-millisecond page clock observations of the DOM, including synchronous layout reads for row geometry. The sample has two trials per build. Paint, native input dispatch, resource utilization and background settlement were outside the measured endpoints. Process admission screens for competing build/test processes at entry and exit and can miss work between snapshots.
protocol.pilotScope: The primary table uses the committed comparison and the viewport-fill observer. An earlier cohort used the same endpoint. The first-option-only pilots are excluded.
protocol.rawRetention: Raw committed and historical finder logs, both finder functional logs and full process-admission receipts are retained locally under .boris/trunk440-sixth/. This record carries their sample results and fingerprints.

finderFunctional.fixture: Separate candidate launch with 2,000 project files and the same two later paths, for 2,002 results.
finderFunctional.tabOrderEvidence: The native probe read mounted options' tabIndex and activeElement. The component test in src/components/FileFinder.test.ts asserts tabIndex 0 for the input and -1 for the list and options.
finderFunctional.replay: Use fixture(repo, 2000) from runnerPy and launch the candidate. Open Review and Comment on a file. Inspect #file-finder-list options for aria-posinset, aria-setsize and tabIndex, and compare activeElement with the combobox. Send drive key Meta+= and read window.innerWidth and list geometry after two requestAnimationFrame callbacks. Press PageDown and read aria-posinset on the selected option. Set the list scrollTop to scrollHeight, wait for option 2002, click it and read [data-testid=diff-path]. Send Escape to close that diff, reopen the finder, type file-0123, wait for one result, press Enter and read the path.

firstAttempt.result: Opened project/file-1999.txt. A click to reopen the finder then timed out after 20,000 ms while the file diff was open.

finderFunctional.successfulReopen: After opening the final option, the successful probe pressed Escape, reopened the finder, typed file-0123, and pressed Enter.

scrollThenEnter.fixture: One native probe per version on the 2,002-path fixture. Scroll the result list to its end by setting scrollTop while the combobox has focus, wait for the last option, then press Enter.

rebasePreview.native: On C2 choose Interactive Rebase... and read the toolbar. Both baseline trials displayed Rebasing main onto release. Both final trials displayed Rebasing main onto 655ba48, the parent of C2.

headless.recipe: In the committed final checkout run mise exec -- just app-test after installing dependencies.
headless.assertion: Each case computes the expected base's short SHA from the graph with app.repo.shaOf(base). The exact toolbar label is Rebasing main onto followed by that SHA. From choosing the context menu entry through reading the toolbar, filter the calls to get_rebase_todo, list_refs and resolve_ref. The asserted sequence is [get_rebase_todo].
headless.scope: Headless application harness with the Svelte UI and real Rust host. Both cases end at the preview toolbar.

cases.C3: The base is C2. Tag decoy points to C2 and branch decoy points to C3.
cases.C2: The base is C1, which has no ref pointing to it.

reproduction.prerequisites: macOS, Git with SHA-1 as the default object format, Python 3.11+, mise and the two drive builds.
reproduction.run: From the checkout containing the record, run FILES=8000 python3 -B "$E20_REPLAY_DIR/runner.py" <absolute-drive-binary> <new-output-directory> once per sample. Use baseline, final, final, baseline in serial order and retain samples whose process-admission.json admits both endpoints.

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
CLI = ["mise", "exec", "--", "bun", "scripts/drive/drive.ts"]
ROWS = '[data-testid="commit-row-summary"]'
import json
Q = json.dumps
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts/diff-scroll"))
from process_admission import measurement_window


@contextmanager
def drive(repo, binary):
    path = Path(subprocess.check_output([*CLI, "launch", binary, str(repo)], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip())
    env = {**os.environ, "TRUNK_DRIVE_DIR": str(path)}

    def call(*args):
        return subprocess.check_output([*CLI, *args], cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, timeout=65).strip()

    try:
        call("until", f"document.querySelector({Q(ROWS)})?.innerText")
        yield call
    finally:
        call("quit")
        if path.name.startswith("trunk-drive-") and set(os.listdir(path)) <= {"app.log", "data", "listening", "drive.sock"}:
            shutil.rmtree(path)


def fixture(repo,n):
    env={**os.environ,'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM':'1','GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL':os.devnull,'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0'}
    def git(*args,data=None):
        return subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True).stdout
    git('init','-qb','main')
    raw='blob\nmark :1\ndata 2\nx\n\n'
    for index in range(3):
        raw+=f'commit refs/heads/main\nmark :{index+2}\ncommitter Fixture <fixture@invalid> {1700000000+index} +0000\ndata 2\nC{index+1}\n'
        if index:raw+=f'from :{index+1}\nM 100644 :1 change-{index}.txt\n'
        else:raw+=''.join(f'M 100644 :1 project/file-{i:04}.txt\n' for i in range(n))
        raw+='\n'
    git('fast-import','--quiet',data=raw.encode());git('reset','--hard','-q','HEAD')
    git('update-ref','refs/heads/release','HEAD~1');git('update-ref','refs/tags/release','HEAD~2')
    git('update-ref','--stdin',data=''.join(f'create refs/heads/topic-{i:03} HEAD\n' for i in range(60)).encode())
    return git('rev-parse','--short=7','HEAD~2').decode().strip()


def run(binary,repo):
    base=fixture(repo,int(os.environ.get("FILES","2000")))
    with drive(repo,binary) as d:
        d('eval',"""[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="commit-row-summary"]')].find(x=>x.textContent==='C2').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true}))""")
        d('choose','Interactive Rebase...')
        print('rebase',d('until',"document.querySelector('.rebase-editor .rebase-toolbar-left')?.innerText"),'expected base',base,flush=True)
    with drive(repo,binary) as d:
        d('click','button','Review')
        d('until',"""[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(e=>e.innerText.includes('Comment on a file'))""")
        print('finder',d('eval',"""(async()=>{const open=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Comment on a file'));const start=performance.now();let inputAt=null,firstRowAt=null;return new Promise(resolve=>{const watch=new MutationObserver(()=>{const input=document.querySelector('input[role=combobox]');if(!input)return;inputAt??=performance.now()-start;const options=[...document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="Tracked files"] [role=option]')];if(!options.length)return;const list=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Tracked files"]');const height=options[0].getBoundingClientRect().height;firstRowAt??=performance.now()-start;if(options.length<Math.ceil(list.clientHeight/height))return;watch.disconnect();resolve({inputMs:inputAt,firstRowMs:firstRowAt,rowsMs:performance.now()-start,rows:options.length,first:options[0].textContent.trim(),last:options.at(-1).textContent.trim(),focus:input===document.activeElement,height,viewport:document.querySelector('[aria-label="Tracked files"]').clientHeight});});watch.observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,attributes:true});open.click()})})()"""),flush=True)
        print('narrow',d('eval',"""(async()=>{const input=document.querySelector('input[role=combobox]');input.value='file-1999';const start=performance.now();input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await Promise.resolve();const opts=[...document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="Tracked files"] [role=option]')];return {rows:opts.length,first:opts[0]?.textContent.trim(),ms:performance.now()-start}})()"""),flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    binary = str(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve())
    output = Path(sys.argv[2])
    output.mkdir()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="trunk440-sixth-", dir="/tmp") as temp, measurement_window(output):
        run(binary, Path(temp))

import hashlib
import json
import os
import runpy
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = Path.cwd()
drive_repository = runpy.run_path(str(HERE / "runner.py"))["drive"]
DIALOG = 'dialog[aria-label="Open a recent repository"]'
SEARCH = f'{DIALOG} input[aria-label="Search recent repositories"]'
ROWS = '[data-testid="commit-row-summary"]'
Q = json.dumps


def git(*args, data=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], input=data, text=True, cwd=ROOT).strip()


def fixture(parent, letter):
    path = parent / f"Picker-{letter}"
    path.mkdir()
    git("-C", str(path), "init", "-qb", "main")
    summary = f"native-picker-{letter}-oracle"
    commands = (
        "blob\nmark :1\ndata 2\nx\n\n"
        "commit refs/heads/main\n"
        "committer Fixture <fixture@invalid> 1700000000 +0000\n"
        f"data {len(summary)}\n{summary}\n"
        "M 100644 :1 tracked.txt\n\n"
    )
    git("-C", str(path), "fast-import", "--quiet", data=commands)
    git("-C", str(path), "reset", "--hard", "-q", "HEAD")
    return {
        "path": str(path), "name": path.name, "summary": summary,
        "head": git("-C", str(path), "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
    }


def evaluate(drive, expression):
    return json.loads(drive("eval", f"(async () => JSON.stringify(await ({expression})))()"))


def invoke(drive, command, args):
    return json.loads(drive("invoke", command, Q(args)))


def snapshot(drive, repos):
    ui = evaluate(drive, f"""({{
        tabs: [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tablist] [role=tab]')]
            .filter(e => e.closest('[role=tablist]')?.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Repository tabs')
            .map(e => ({{
            text: e.innerText.trim(), selected: e.getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true'
        }})),
        graph: [...document.querySelectorAll({Q(ROWS)})]
            .filter(e => !e.closest('[inert]')).map(e => e.innerText),
        pickerOpen: Boolean(document.querySelector({Q(DIALOG + '[open]')})),
        pickerStatus: document.querySelector({Q(DIALOG + ' [role=status]')})?.innerText.trim() ?? '',
        searchFocused: document.activeElement === document.querySelector({Q(SEARCH)}),
        alerts: [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert]')].map(e => e.innerText)
    }})""")
    ui["recent"] = invoke(drive, "prefs_get", {"key": "recent_repos"})
    ui["open_tabs"] = invoke(drive, "prefs_get", {"key": "open_tabs"})
    ui["native_head"] = {}
    for letter, repo in repos.items():
        path = Q(repo["path"])
        ui["native_head"][letter] = evaluate(
            drive,
            f'window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke("head_oid", {{path: {path}}})'
            '.then(value => ({value}), error => ({error: JSON.parse(error).code}))',
        )
    return ui


def wait_graph(drive, repo):
    summary = Q(repo["summary"])
    drive("until", f"""[...document.querySelectorAll({Q(ROWS)})].some(
        e => !e.closest('[inert]') && e.innerText === {summary})""")


def show_picker(drive):
    drive("key", "Ctrl+r")
    drive("until", f"document.activeElement === document.querySelector({Q(SEARCH)})")
    drive("until", f"document.querySelectorAll({Q(DIALOG + ' [role=option]')}).length === 3")


def select(drive, repo):
    options = json.loads(drive("list", "option"))
    [name] = [item for item in options if item.startswith(repo["name"])]
    drive("click", "option", name)


def await_event(drive, phase, command, repo):
    drive("eval", f"window.pickerNative.waitFor(event => event.phase === {Q(phase)}"
          f" && event.command === {Q(command)} && event.path === {Q(repo['path'])}"
          " && event.outcome === 'ok')")


def replay(drive, repos, escape, expect_fixed, record):
    a, b, c = (repos[key] for key in "ABC")
    seeded = [{key: repos[letter][key] for key in ("path", "name")} for letter in "BCA"]
    invoke(drive, "prefs_set", {"key": "recent_repos", "value": seeded})
    drive("eval", (HERE / "gate.js").read_text())
    wait_graph(drive, a)
    show_picker(drive)
    drive("eval", f"window.pickerNative.arm({Q(b['path'])})")
    highlighted = DIALOG + ' [role=option][aria-selected=true]'
    assert evaluate(drive, f"document.querySelector({Q(highlighted)})?.innerText"), highlighted
    assert evaluate(drive, f"document.querySelector({Q(highlighted)}).innerText").startswith(b["name"])
    drive("key", "Enter")
    await_event(drive, "native-reply", "open_repo", b)
    held = evaluate(drive, "window.pickerNative.held")
    assert held["outcome"] == "ok", held
    record["B_native_response_held"] = held
    record["while_B_held"] = snapshot(drive, repos)
    assert record["while_B_held"]["graph"] == [a["summary"]], record
    assert record["while_B_held"]["native_head"]["B"] == {"value": b["head"]}, record

    if escape:
        assert record["while_B_held"]["searchFocused"]
        drive("key", "Escape")
        drive("until", f"!document.querySelector({Q(DIALOG + '[open]')})")
    else:
        select(drive, c)
        wait_graph(drive, c)
        await_event(drive, "delivered", "close_repo", a)
    if not escape:
        drive("eval", """window.pickerNative.waitFor(event => event.phase === 'delivered'
            && event.command === 'prefs_set' && event.key === 'recent_repos'
            && event.outcome === 'ok' && event.value[0]?.name === 'Picker-C')""")
    record["before_B_delivery"] = snapshot(drive, repos)
    assert evaluate(drive, "window.pickerNative.held") == held
    drive("eval", "window.pickerNative.release()")

    if expect_fixed:
        await_event(drive, "delivered", "close_repo", b)
        wait_graph(drive, a if escape else c)
    else:
        wait_graph(drive, b)
        if not escape:
            await_event(drive, "delivered", "close_repo", c)
    after = record["after_B_delivery"] = snapshot(drive, repos)
    expected_tab = a if escape else c
    expected_recents = ["Picker-B", "Picker-C", "Picker-A"] if escape else ["Picker-C", "Picker-B", "Picker-A"]
    record["oracle"] = {
        "only_latest_history": after["graph"] == [expected_tab["summary"]],
        "only_latest_selected_tab": after["tabs"] == [{"text": expected_tab["name"], "selected": True}],
        "winning_tab_saved": [tab["repoName"] for tab in after["open_tabs"]] == [expected_tab["name"]],
        "recents_order": [repo["name"] for repo in after["recent"]] == expected_recents,
        "unused_B_closed": after["native_head"]["B"] == {"error": "not_open"},
        "winning_repo_open": after["native_head"]["A" if escape else "C"] == {"value": expected_tab["head"]},
        "picker_closed": not after["pickerOpen"],
        "no_alert": not after["alerts"],
    }


def binary_digest(path):
    with path.open("rb") as binary_file:
        return hashlib.file_digest(binary_file, "sha256").hexdigest()


def main():
    phase = sys.argv[1]
    assert phase in ("baseline", "candidate", "integration", "final")
    expect_fixed = phase != "baseline"
    binary = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
    expected_digest = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else binary_digest(binary)
    source_tree = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else None
    base = Path("/tmp").resolve()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=f"trunk-picker-{phase}-", dir=base) as name:
        parent = Path(name)
        isolated = parent / "xdg"
        isolated.mkdir()
        for key in [key for key in os.environ if key.startswith("GIT_")]:
            del os.environ[key]
        os.environ.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,
                          GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0", XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(isolated))
        repos = {letter: fixture(parent, letter) for letter in "ABC"}
        results = {
            "binary": str(binary), "expected_binary_sha256": expected_digest,
            "checkout_HEAD": git("rev-parse", "HEAD"), "build_source_tree": source_tree,
            "fixtures": repos, "cases": {},
        }
        failed = False
        for case in ("last-gesture", "escape"):
            record = results["cases"][case] = {"binary_sha256_at_launch": binary_digest(binary)}
            assert record["binary_sha256_at_launch"] == expected_digest, record
            with drive_repository(Path(repos["A"]["path"]), str(binary)) as drive:
                try:
                    replay(drive, repos, case == "escape", expect_fixed, record)
                except Exception as error:
                    record["probe_error"] = str(error)
                    failed = True
                finally:
                    record["ipc"] = evaluate(drive, "window.pickerNative?.events ?? []")
            print(f"{phase} {case}: {record.get('oracle', record.get('probe_error'))}", flush=True)
    results["fixture_root_removed"] = not parent.exists()
    results["binary_sha256_at_end"] = binary_digest(binary)
    with (HERE / f"{phase}.json").open("x") as result_file:
        result_file.write(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + "\n")
    return int(failed or results["binary_sha256_at_end"] != expected_digest or (expect_fixed and not all(
        all(case.get("oracle", {}).values()) for case in results["cases"].values()
    )))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from pathlib import Path

helpers = run_path(str(Path(__file__).with_name("runner.py")))

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='/tmp',prefix='trunk440-rebase-head-') as temp:
    repo=Path(temp)
    for key in [key for key in os.environ if key.startswith("GIT_")]:
        del os.environ[key]
    os.environ.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull)
    fixture(repo,3)
    def git(*args):
        return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),*args],text=True).strip()
    git('config','--local','user.email','fixture@invalid')
    git('config','--local','user.name','Fixture')
    git('config','--local','commit.gpgsign','false')
    tip=git('rev-parse','HEAD')
    with drive(repo, str(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve())) as d:
        d('eval',"""[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="commit-row-summary"]')].find(x=>x.textContent==='C2').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true}))""")
        d('choose','Interactive Rebase...')
        label=d('until',"document.querySelector('.rebase-editor .rebase-toolbar-left')?.innerText")
        assert 'main' in label,label
        d('eval',"""(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.rebase-editor select[aria-label$="for C2"]');s.value='drop';s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));return s.value})()""")
        git('checkout','-q','topic-000')

"""Scroll the ranked finder results, then use the keyboard without touching the mouse."""
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys,tempfile
from runpy import run_path

helpers = run_path(str(Path(__file__).with_name("runner.py")))
fixture = helpers["fixture"]
drive = helpers["drive"]

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='trunk440-mixed-',dir='/tmp') as temp:
    repo=Path(temp)
    fixture(repo,2000)
    with drive(repo, str(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve())) as d:
        d('click','button','Review')
        d('click','button','Comment on a file…')
        d('until',"!!document.querySelector('[role=option][aria-posinset=\"2\"]')")
        d('eval',"document.querySelector('#file-finder-list').scrollTop=document.querySelector('#file-finder-list').scrollHeight")
        d('until',"!!document.querySelector('[role=option][aria-posinset=\"2002\"]')")
        state=json.loads(d('eval',"""(()=>{const input=document.querySelector('[role=combobox]');const list=document.querySelector('#file-finder-list');const box=list.getBoundingClientRect();const visible=[...list.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')].filter(row=>{const r=row.getBoundingClientRect();return r.top<box.bottom && r.bottom>box.top}).map(row=>row.innerText);const selected=list.querySelector('[aria-selected=true]');return {focused:document.activeElement===input,visible,selected:selected?.innerText??null,active:input.getAttribute('aria-activedescendant'),scrollTop:list.scrollTop}})()"""))
        d('key','Enter')
        opened=d('until',"document.querySelector('[data-testid=diff-path]')?.innerText")
        print(json.dumps({'beforeEnter':state,'opened':opened,'openedVisible':opened in state['visible']},indent=2))
